林国栋支支吾吾，把经过说了。

李红霞听完，沉默了好一会儿。

“你骂他啥了？”

林国栋不吭声。

“我问你，你骂他啥了？”

“骂他……有几个臭钱了不起了……”

“还有呢？”

“还有……说他配方是老宅的……”

李红霞一屁股坐在炕沿上，半天没说话。

她虽然偏心，但不傻。

老三骂的那些话，换谁谁不急？

国强现在是什么人？那是连她的面子都不给的人。

老三上赶着去触霉头，不是找揍吗？

“妈，你去找二哥说说……”

“说啥？”李红霞瞪了他一眼，“你自己嘴欠挨了揍，让我去说啥？说你不该骂他？”

林国栋蔫了。

林海柱知道后，蹲在门口抽了半袋烟，说了一句：“该。”

李红霞没接话。

国强饭店这边，赵素梅看着林国强，欲言又止。

“想问啥就问。”

“你真揍老三了？”

“揍了。”

“揍得厉害吗？”

“鼻青脸肿。”

赵素梅沉默了一会儿：“他骂你啥了？”

“骂我有几个臭钱了不起了。”

赵素梅没再问了。

她知道林国强的脾气。

要不是老三骂得太过分，他不会动手。

而且，老三那个人确实该揍。

好吃懒做，眼高手低，还嘴欠。

“揍了就揍了。”赵素梅端起碗吃饭，“省得他以后再来烦你。”

林国强看了她一眼，笑了。

他家素梅，现在是真的硬气了。

月底，八亩半荒地翻整出来了。

张老四带着三个人，干了整整半个月。

草根刨干净了，地垄重新打了，水渠也修通了。

新翻的泥土黑油油的，在太阳底下泛着光。

林国强站在地头，看着这片地。

十三亩半地，加上蔬菜大棚，够饭店用了。

张老四凑过来问下一步种啥。

林国强早就想好了，秋菜种白菜萝卜，再种一茬秋豆角。

大棚里育苗的事他亲自盯着，西红柿、黄瓜、辣椒，春节前后上市，能卖个好价钱。

Lin Guodong hesitated and told the story.

After Li Hongxia listened, she was silent for a while.

"What did you scold him for?"

Lin Guodong remained silent.

"Let me ask you, what did you scold him for?"

"Scold him...it's a big deal for a few bad guys..."

"What else?"

"Also... said that his recipe is from the old house..."

Li Hongxia sat down on the edge of the kang and didn't speak for a long time.

Although she is biased, she is not stupid.

Who else would be less anxious about the words that the third child scolded?

Who is Guoqiang now?That was someone who didn't even give her face.

The third child rushes to get into trouble, isn't he looking for a beating?

"Mom, go talk to your second brother..."

"What did you say?" Li Hongxia glared at him, "You were beaten for your tongue. What did you ask me to say? That you shouldn't scold him?"

Lin Guodong languished.

After Lin Haizhu found out, he squatted at the door, smoked half a pack of cigarettes, and said, "That's right."

Li Hongxia didn't answer.

Over at Guoqiang Hotel, Zhao Sumei looked at Lin Guoqiang and hesitated to speak.

"Ask whatever you want."

"Did you really beat the third child?"

"Beat."

"Was it a severe beating?"

"Bruised nose and swollen face."

Zhao Sumei was silent for a while: "What did he scold you for?"

"It's a big deal to call me a stinker."

Zhao Sumei didn't ask any more questions.

She knew Lin Guoqiang's temper.

If the third child hadn't scolded him too much, he wouldn't have done anything.

Moreover, the third child really deserves to be beaten.

Tasty and lazy, high-minded and low-handed.

"Just beat him up." Zhao Sumei picked up the bowl and ate. "This will save him from bothering you again in the future."

Lin Guoqiang glanced at her and smiled.

His Sumei is really tough now.

At the end of the month, eight and a half acres of wasteland were cleared.

Zhang Laosi and three people worked for half a month.

The grass roots were dug out, the ridges were dug again, and the ditches were repaired.

The newly turned soil was black and oily, glowing in the sun.

Lin Guoqiang stood at the edge of the field and looked at the land.

Thirteen and a half acres of land, plus a vegetable greenhouse, is enough for a restaurant.

Zhang Laosi came over and asked what to plant next.

Lin Guoqiang had already thought about planting cabbage, radish and autumn beans.

He personally keeps an eye on the seedling raising in the greenhouse. Tomatoes, cucumbers, and peppers are on the market around the Spring Festival and can be sold at a good price.
